topic.readerProblem: A founder, marketer or agency lead wants to know which AI visibility, AEO or GEO tool fits their situation (one-off audit, always-on tracking, enterprise program or an SEO-suite add-on) without paying for the wrong job.
topic.connection: AEOeye sells a one-off AI visibility audit. This page maps the whole tool category, states plainly where trackers, enterprise platforms and SEO suites beat AEOeye, and tells readers when not to buy it.

assessment: The page answers the buyer's question in the first screen (match the tool to the job), then compares 15 tools from each vendor's own pricing or product page checked on 2026-10-03, with engines, entry price, billing basis and best fit. It discloses near the top that it is documentation-based and that nothing was tested hands-on, labels AEOeye as the publisher's own product, and says where trackers and enterprise platforms beat it. It rests on vendor documentation, OpenAI, Google and arXiv primary sources, one third-party study with a disclosed vendor tie (SparkToro with Gumshoe.ai), and AEOeye's own crawler access study and audit records with their sample caveats. It deliberately does not rank tools, claim hands-on testing, quote vendor-reported performance as fact, or promise any outcome.

sources.supports: GEO is also known as AEO (and AIO): the practice of improving visibility in responses generated by generative AI systems; basis for calling them two names for the same practice.
Paper 'GEO: Generative Engine Optimization' (Aggarwal et al., KDD 2024) introduces GEO for content visibility in generative engine responses.
OAI-SearchBot surfaces sites in ChatGPT search and sites that disallow it will not be shown in ChatGPT search answers; GPTBot is for training; robots.txt applies to both.
Growth $100/month ($1,000/year; 1 brand, 50 prompts, 8 models incl. Claude); Scale $500/month with white-label client portals and REST API; Enterprise from $1,000/month billed annually.
Eight models on every plan; each tracked prompt runs against all eight every day; prompts go to the providers' own APIs; any prompt can be opened to read the response behind a score.
All in One $79/month marked limited time, 500 prompts, engines incl. Claude and Gemini, weekly reports, 7-day trial; the product tracks keywords and derives prompts from them.
Starter EUR 79/month billed yearly (EUR 948 a year), 50 AI prompts tracked daily, 14-day trial; ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity, AI Mode and AI Overviews on every plan.
Lite $29/month for 15 prompts; core engines ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, Perplexity, Copilot; Gemini, AI Mode and Claude are paid add-ons.

Peec's own plan summary dated July 2026: Starter $95/month, 50 prompts, 3 active models, daily; six engines included, Claude and others as paid add-on models; ChatGPT tracked by UI simulation and the OpenAI Search API listed as a separate model.

Pro $99/month with 1,200 credits and a 7-day trial; engines incl. ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, Claude, Copilot and more; credits meter every AI query; Growth lists white-label options and REST API; a cheaper Essentials plan is also listed.
Free 7-day trial (50 prompts daily on ChatGPT, Gemini, Google AI Overviews; recommended prompt set, no custom prompts); Enterprise is custom with up to 9 engines, SSO/SAML and SOC 2.
Samples each prompt up to 100 times per model across 11 models; pricing only through a demo request.
Free Essential tier, Starter $295/month with 11 models and on-page and off-page actions; Enterprise is custom.
Core $250/month: 125 prompts, five site audits a month, four platforms without Claude; Enterprise custom with nine platforms incl. Claude; 7-day trial.
Positions itself as an AI visibility platform for enterprise brands; demo or sales contact only, no public pricing.
AI Visibility Toolkit Base $99/month per domain billed annually: 25 custom prompts, ChatGPT, Google AI, Gemini and Perplexity.
Custom prompts from $50/month (page says free on paid Lite plans and above); AI Visibility Index from $199/month over 448M+ prompts and best once a brand already appears in AI search.
Core $103.20/month annual ($129 monthly) listing 100 daily prompts; AI Search add-on +$71.20/month annual ($89 monthly) for 200 prompts across AI Overviews, AI Mode, Perplexity and ChatGPT.
No additional requirements, special optimizations, new files or special schema are needed to appear in AI Overviews or AI Mode; a page must be indexed and snippet-eligible.
Using generative AI to generate many pages without adding value for users may violate Google's spam policy on scaled content abuse.
Chat Completions and Completions APIs are non-deterministic by default, so model outputs may differ from request to request.

SparkToro with Gumshoe.ai (author discloses the commercial tie): 600 volunteers, 12 prompts, 2,961 runs on ChatGPT, Claude and Google AI; under 1-in-100 chance of the same brand list; visibility percentage across many runs called a reasonable metric.
